message.content: {"scores":{"c1":7,"c2":6,"c3":6},"evidence":"Word count is about 64. That is below the 70–92 window by roughly 21%, which is a deduction. The opening \"Только вот этот контроль...\" joins cleanly to the fragment and nothing is repeated. On c2, the toggles-versus-responsibility critique does develop the idea of control. The voice, though, is more fluent and generic than the terse excerpt: \"когнитивную нагрузку\" and \"в идеале должны остаться незаметными\" read as standard design talk. There is also no link to Apple's actual wording. On c3, nothing is invented and there is no personal experience. However, the piece closes with polished quotable lines (\"не простоту, а видимость её\", \"циничным ходом\"). The argument itself restates the familiar settings-overload thesis without specific support."}
